technical_requirements: Languages: EN, FR, DE, ES, PT-BR, ZH-CN, JA, NL — per-language recall target: >= 86% on gold sets
Search latency: first-pass (ANN) median <150ms, 95th <300ms across EU region
Reranker latency: p95 <450ms; prefer batched rerank operations over single-pass expensive models
Throughput: 150 req/s sustained for peak internal dashboard queries
Indexing cadence: nightly bulk + continuous incremental; re-embedding job window <= 6 hours for deltas
Storage: retention of raw docs + embeddings for 7 years (compliance requirement)
Cost target: average end-to-end cost per query (ANN + rerank) <= $0.02; willing to trade some latency for lower unit cost via quantized models and batching
poC_details: Scope: 3-month POC, sampling 20M documents (mix of contracts, briefs, internal wiki)
Success metrics: per-language recall/precision, p95 latency, cost per query estimate, reranker improvement over BM25 baseline
Evaluation harness: built by Orchid using Redwood SDK + custom per-lang test suites (Drive: /deals/orchid/poc-harness.zip)
Rollout plan: canary in EU region -> dedicated pool if SLA met -> private appliance for specific client accounts
security_review_status: Needs: SOC2 type II report, KMS/HSM architecture diagram, SAML SSO integration guide
Data residency: EU-only for client case files; Redwood to confirm region pinning and audit log retention
perf_cost_constraints: Index size: targeting 120M documents (~30-40TB raw, ~8-12TB embeddings in float16 before quantization)
Target cost: <= $0.02/query avg; budget-constrained seasonality (Q3 ramp)
Preferred levers: quantized models for rerank, prefix KV caching for frequent queries, hybrid routing to lower-cost model variants during off-peak
